d: America’s midterm elections could reshape President Donald Trump’s political power and influence decisions on conflicts, trade and global security. Although Trump is not on the ballot, voters will decide control of the House of Representatives and the Senate, determining how easily his administration can push its agenda. In this video, Firstpost explains what is at stake for India, from US tariffs and H-1B visas to oil prices and stock market performance.
